verdict.rationale: Bolt's docs and repo describe building from a blank natural-language prompt with no code required. The AI gets full control of the environment (filesystem, Node server, package manager, terminal) and can deploy from chat. The app gets built-in database, auth, Supabase backend and hosting. Hands-on reports confirm working apps built in minutes and 'idea to prod in a day' with 99% of edits via prompts. Other users report the app breaking after adding a database and 'doom loops' of regressions on proofs of concept, but these are mixed results rather than a contradiction of the core capability. Missing for 10: consistent reliability on more complex full-stack builds (backend/DB additions causing errors and fix-break cycles), and independent evidence of a production-grade backend beyond the Supabase/Bolt Database integrations.
